P15m: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when things like that are required as pre-reqs for people to get medicine, it can put power in the hands of the gatekeepers, right when people are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that people disclose whatever the group wants them to.
